data.body: 2026-09-28, follow-up to task 150 (finished): the ask-question dialog is 780px wide, declared in desktop/src/chat/question.css as `.workbench-dialog.question-dialog { max-width: 780px }` — 1.5x the 520px task 150 specified, and 1.77x the 440px it actually rendered at. 660px was the first pass (1.5x of the on-screen 440px); review judged it still too narrow and the user confirmed 780px as correct on 2026-09-28. Cascade trap worth keeping: the base `.workbench-dialog` rule (max-width 440px, width calc(100% - 32px)) is bundled after question.css, so a one-class override loses the tie — name both classes. Verified 780px at a 1400px viewport and 528px at 560px, no overflow; tsc clean, 230 chat tests pass. The app embeds dist at compile time (devUrl is null), so a width change needs a frontend build plus a release rebuild before a restart shows it. This note corrects and supersedes question-dialog-width-20260928, which recorded 660px.
